items.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20
items.q: It used to be Tremé, Mark.

ctx.x: In the Tremé section. What, right off? That's St. Anne Street. Green, Cleveland, and Derby. Oh, yeah. Blocked from the old Tremé. It used to be Tremé, Mark. It was in the Darlene. In the Darlene Street.
Oh, I see. Well, how did you learn this number, Hey, La, Ba?
